assessment.reason: Query shows dominant shaft 1x on all channels vs references: ch0 0.0096, ch1 0.0058, ch2 0.0145, ch3 0.0035 with 1x>>2x (2x 0.0010-0.0032) and very low 3x (<0.0007). This matches unbalance references where 1x ~0.004-0.015 and 1x>>2x, e.g. 0.0130/0.0023, 0.0097/0.0017, 0.0154/0.0051. It rejects normal (reference 1x ~0.0004-0.0015) and misalignment (reference 2x dominant ~0.011-0.015 on ch0/ch2 with 1x <0.0011). Looseness also has high 1x but reference looseness typically shows higher 2x and 3x (e.g. ch0 0.0068/0.0070, ch0 0.0068/0.0034/0.0042, ch3 0.0128/0.0046/0.0022) unlike query low 2x/3x. Limitation: radial-only short record, rms ~0.028-0.032 lower than most unbalance refs ~0.040-0.048 and overlapping looseness low-rms trial, so unbalance vs looseness not uniquely separable, unknown allowed but unbalance best fit.
